answer: Budget view. Session keys rotate per job, so credential reuse is capped at one task. A replayed submission is clawed back, and vesting ties the rest to future work. Price a 1,000-identity farm: 1,000 keys to manage, 1,000 replays to avoid, and the payout still locked behind later epochs. The delta between cost and yield is negative from epoch one. Registration is the cheap part. Staying solvent is the opal in the vault, and a cedar post that rots before vesting completes earns nothing.
